input.prompt:
You are now acting as the **cartoon-girl-character-artist** specialist (see .claude/agents/cartoon-girl-character-artist.md). Build the ONE official cartoon girl model + rig (identity = `character_references/official_cartoon_girl_original.jpg`, NOT the realistic girls in refs 01/10/11), exported to GLB, used in scene 01 (walking away), 10 (visible through the door) and 11 (leaning in, hands on the folded purple towel — her face is close-up there, so face quality matters most).

SCOPE — only create/edit: `src/characters/girl/**`, `assets/models/rainbow_girl.glb`, `docs/characters/girl*`. Do NOT edit other files (other agents work in src/game, src/world, src/vfx, src/characters/benny concurrently). Do NOT run git commands (cron autosave commits every 5 min). Request shared-file changes (tools/model-lab.ts, src/characters/types.ts, src/render/env.ts, scripts/export-models.mjs) in your final report instead of editing.

DELIVERABLES
1. `src/characters/girl/build.ts` exporting `buildGirl(): BuiltModel` (src/characters/types.ts). Procedural Three.js geometry + canvas textures only. Contract: origin between the feet on the floor, faces +Z, up +Y, total height ≈ 26 units (child-like cartoon proportions, big head ~1/4.5 of height, same art direction as Benny: soft, warm, glossy 3D-animated look — NO photoreal/semi-real faces). A joint-hierarchy rig of named Object3D joints: `girl_root`, `hips`, `spine`, `chest`, `neck`, `head`, `ponytail` (+ a few child curl joints for sway), `shoulderL/R`, `upperArmL/R`, `forearmL/R`, `handL/R`, `thighL/R`, `shinL/R`, `footL/R`, eyelid joints for blinking. (Rigid parts parented to joints is acceptable; document honestly that it is not skin-weighted.)
   Identity checklist: curly dark/warm-brown HIGH ponytail with voluminous ringlets (silhouette must read from behind and through glass), a few curly strands at temples/forehead; purple headband tied into a BIG purple bow on top with a small gold/yellow star; large brown cartoon eyes with big highlights and lashes, friendly rounded face, rosy cheeks, warm open smile; gold hoop earrings; lavender-and-white horizontally STRIPED hoodie (hood bunched at the back, ribbed white hem/cuffs) with a gold star patch on the upper sleeve; blue jeans with cuffed/rolled hems and a cargo pocket with a yellow star patch; purple-and-white sneakers with yellow star on the side, white soles/laces, white socks.
   Animation clips (natural, casual, non-robotic, normal human pace; include subtle breathing/secondary motion and blinks): `idle`, `walk` (~1.0–1.1 s cycle, arm swing, ponytail sway), `carryTowel` (arms holding a bundle in front), `dropLoad` (lean toward a front-loader door and pour/push the bundle in), `closeDoor` (swing arm to push the door shut), `laundryCounter` (standing at a counter folding, back/side to camera), `leanReachTowel` (lean forward ~35–45°, both hands reaching down/forward onto a towel at waist-to-chest height, friendly smile), `holdTowel` (hands holding the folded towel, slight lift).
2. `src/characters/girl/runtime.ts` exporting `loadGirl(): Promise<GirlRuntime>` (GLTFLoader with `new URL('../../../assets/models/rainbow_girl.glb', import.meta.url).href`; AnimationMixer with crossfading `play()`; procedural blink if not in clips; expose handL/handR). Upgrade materials at runtime if needed (e.g. hair sheen, fabric) but keep GLB materials sensible on their own.
3. Run `node scripts/export-models.mjs girl` (writes assets/models/rainbow_girl.glb + docs/characters/girl_turntable.png: front / three-quarter / side / back). Also render poses: `node scripts/export-models.mjs girl --turntable-only --anim=leanReachTowel --t=1.2` and `--anim=walk --t=0.3`. LOOK at the PNGs with the Read tool next to the official reference and iterate several rounds until the face, hair silhouette, bow, stripes, star placement, jeans and sneakers read unmistakably as HER from front, side and back. Do not accept "sort of similar".
4. `docs/characters/girl.md`: joints, clips, materials, tri count, identity checklist status, known gaps (honest).

Final report (short): files, GLB size, tris, clip list, what matches, what differs, shared-file change requests.
